keyword: man city vs real madrid lineups

Kylian Mbappé is on the bench for Real Madrid.

Real Madrid's starting midfielders are Federico Valverde, Thiago Pitarch, Aurélien Tchouaméni, and Arda Güler.
Real Madrid's starting forwards are Brahim Díaz and Vinicius Jr.

Manchester City's starting defenders are Matheus Nunes, Abdukodir Khusanov, Ruben Dias, and Rayan Aït-Nouri.
